title: Unenclosed perimeter protection inspection, use, adjustment, maintenance, and repair.
officialText:
Safety net systems, guardrail
systems, and alternative systems authorized under Section 3308.8 shall be inspected, used, adjusted, maintained, repaired, and
replaced in accordance with the design drawings, manufacturer recommendations, and the requirements of this code.
